changelog:
Snibet Viral Claw is an AI agent that writes one high-quality X tweet at a time for founders and builders.

It turns rough ideas into sharp, post-ready tweets designed to spark replies and engagement.

You can adjust creator mode, style, and tone to match your voice while keeping the output clean, human, and instantly publishable.
summary: Snibet-native OpenClaw tweet engine. Generates exactly one high-performance X tweet for builders with strict formatting, creator modes, and anti-AI cleanup.
